## S&P 500 futures slip as rising yields weigh on market sentiment

Sustained yield pressure is an immediate headwind to high-multiple tech names; a risk-off open can set a negative sentiment backdrop even when underlying earnings narratives remain intact.

- Equity futures markets are signaling early risk-off, with higher yields cited as the driver
- Move is macro-driven, not tied to a specific company or earnings event
- Tech-growth equities carry above-average duration sensitivity and are disproportionately exposed to yield-driven de-rating
